A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LMLM research work. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A–D are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original pretraining, factual-precision, language-understanding, and TOFU unlearning results, together with ablations and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, although it adds no new experiment.

M1.justification: The annotation pipeline, masked training objective, structured lookups, retrieval mechanism, and database-based unlearning are unchanged. Token labels revised in Tables 11–12 match the format already specified in v1 Appendix A.3; they do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Wikipedia and SQuAD-v2 data preparation and the same Wikipedia perplexity, FactScore, T-REx, TOFU, and five NLU benchmark evaluations. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the STANDARD/off-the-shelf evaluations, Table 2's RAG comparison, the TOFU comparisons, and the appendix examples. The expanded RAG passage introduces no additional evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Splits, budgets, model configurations, metrics, and testing procedures remain unchanged. Both RAG descriptions specify BM25, four 100-word Wikipedia passages, the same prompt, and no fine-tuning. Changing 'appended' to 'prepended' clarifies the documents-before-query ordering already shown in both versions' prompt template and Table 14.

E4.justification: Database-disabling results, token-loss analyses, entity-frequency analysis, fuzzy-versus-prefix-tree decoding ablations, and qualitative cases are retained. The expanded RAG discussion adds interpretation without a new supplementary experiment or analysis.

E5.justification: TOFU statistical testing and NPO repeated-run, seed, and mean/variance reporting are unchanged. This includes the existing discrepancy between three runs in Appendix B.2 and five runs in B.3.

E6.justification: Appendix C removes v1's explicit qualitative observation that BM25 consistently retrieves highly relevant supporting documents. Numerical results and plotted trends are unchanged: Table 2 retains RAG/LMLM FactScore values of 20.1/23.9 and T-REx EM values of 75.8/58.7. Tables 11–12 preserve the same example content after token relabeling.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 retains the same token definitions, masked training loss in Equation 1, and perplexity/NLL formulations. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about external factual memory, parameter efficiency, factual precision, and instant forgetting. The appendix revision does not redefine their scope.

C2.justification: Appendix C newly suggests that RAG's strong T-REx performance may reflect Wikipedia overlap and verbatim completions, while dropping the assurance that retrieval quality ensures a fair, competitive baseline. Discussion of small-model difficulties and RAG/LMLM complementarity largely repeats existing Section 3.3 material.

D1.justification: Tables 11–12 correct lookup markers from db_entity/db_relationship/db_return to db_start/sep/db_retrieve, aligning technical examples with Appendix A.3. Appendix C also clarifies prompt ordering. These are documentation corrections; hyperparameters, hardware information, and code/data access disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and related-work section are unchanged. Appendix C's expanded account of structured LMLM retrieval versus unstructured RAG, including their complementarity, reiterates positioning already present in Section 3.3.

P1.justification: The RAG appendix passage is locally expanded and retitled, example terminology is standardized, the correspondence footnote is removed, and acknowledgments are updated. The main narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Figures 9 and 10 move from pages 21 and 22 to pages 22 and 23 without graphical changes. Nearby tables shift, Tables 11–12 reflow after token corrections, and the title wraps differently. All figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves internal consistency by aligning example lookup tokens with Appendix A.3 and clarifying RAG prompt ordering. The qualified Wikipedia-overlap explanation also adds useful context for Table 2. These are limited gains in clarity and interpretation: experimental evidence is unchanged, and no test of the new overlap explanation is added.
